Veterinarians
Requests from WCVM research teams for assistance in locating potential participants for animal health research studies at the veterinary college.
WCVM seeking cats with FIP for research study
Researchers at the Western College of Veterinary Medicine (WCVM) are seeking cats that have been diagnosed with feline infectious peritonitis (FIP) to take part in a research study investigating coagulation abnormalities linked to the disease.
WCVM scientists seeking dogs with spreading cancer for clinical trial
Oncology researchers at the Western College of Veterinary Medicine (WCVM) are seeking dogs with spreading cancer for a clinical trial at the WCVM Veterinary Medical Centre.
Urethral obstruction in male cats
If you have clients whose male cat(s) have been diagnosed with urethral obstructions and managed without surgery, please let them know about this online survey.
Researcher seeks newly imported dogs for study
If you have a client who has recently brought a dog into Canada or have links to rescue groups that import dogs into the country, a Western College of Veterinary Medicine (WCVM) researcher wants to hear from you.
Radiation oncology trials
WCVM researchers are seeking canine patients for two radiation oncology clinical trials.
